#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Soulmask server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/soulmask/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="<ROOT>/installs/soulmask/linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/soulmask/" || exit 1
exec ./WS/Binaries/Linux/WSServer-Linux-Shipping WS Level01_Main -server -log -UTF8Output -MULTIHOME=0.0.0.0 -forcepassthrough -Port=8777 -QueryPort=27190 -EchoPort=18888 -SteamServerName="Test World" -MaxPlayers=10 -pve -PSW="$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" -adminpsw="$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" -saving=600 -backup=900 -rconaddr=127.0.0.1 -rconport=19000 -rconpsw="$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD"

#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - 18888 <<'STOP'
import socket, sys, time
try:
    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
    time.sleep(0.5); s.sendall(b"saveworld 1\r\nquit 3\r\n"); time.sleep(1.5); s.close()
except OSError:
    pass
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 245 ] && pgrep -f -- '-Port=8777 -QueryPort' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
